title: The Demonic Path Enters
next_chapter_hook: When the figure of the demonic envoy completely vanished into that eerie black mist, the teacup in Chen Ji's hand suddenly shattered—not from anger, but because he finally realized that on the chessboard he had been arranging for years, a piece he had never calculated had appeared at some point.

text.content: In the instant that gaze vanished, Chen Ji suddenly sensed a familiar aura—the unique scent emanating from Ling Yuan, aged and decaying, yet carrying a heart-stopping pressure. He stood in place, fingertips gently brushing the hidden patterns on his sleeve, and the taut string in his heart tightened several more notches. Three years had passed, and the old fox could no longer remain still. Yet what disturbed him even more was the direction of that vanishing gaze—it wasn't towards the Tianqing Sect, but originated from... the border of the Demonic Path.

The night wind rose suddenly, causing the window lattice to creak. Just as Chen Ji was about to turn back inside, his brow suddenly furrowed, his gaze falling upon the dry well in the courtyard. Where there should have been no one, a black figure now stood. The visitor was shrouded in eerie black mist, features too blurred to discern, only those two eyes—like two ghostly flames—staring at him with great interest.

dialogue.content: Indeed worthy of someone who caught the Holy Sect Saintess's attention—this perceptiveness is truly well-deserved. The black-clad figure's voice was low and hoarse, carrying a playful smile. He stepped forward slowly, black mist churning behind him like a tide about to devour this world. Chen Ji, do you know why I've come?

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, even a faint curve appearing at the corner of his lips. He calmly adjusted his sleeve cuffs, as if this demonic envoy before him was merely a late-night visitor, not a death-dealing deity who could claim his life at any moment. A demonic path figure visiting the Tianqing Sect in the dead of night—surely not here to admire the moon? His voice wascalm得没有一丝波澜，但眼底的vigilant却如寒潭般深邃。

dialogue.content: Admire the moon? The black-clad figure let out a contemptuous laugh, black mist coalescing into a ferocious ghost mask that lunged straight for Chen Ji's face. I've come, sent by the Holy Sect Commander, to offer you a tremendous opportunity. His voice suddenly turned ice-cold, Chen Ji, do you know—what are the Twins of Destiny?

text.content: Twins of Destiny? Chen Ji's brow furrowed almost imperceptibly. He had never encountered this term in any classic, yet somehow these five words alone caused his chest to tighten, as if something long sealed away was being forcibly awakened. He unconsciously clenched his fist, the pain of nails digging into his palm keeping him lucid. No, he said he didn't recognize it.

dialogue.content: Playing dumb? The black-clad figure's laughter grew increasingly sharp and刺耳, you think the Tianji Record chose you by chance? Think you're heaven's chosen? Let me tell you a harsh truth—the Twins of Destiny are a ploy set in motion by the Heavenly Way's will over a thousand years ago. One bears heavenly fate, the other bears a curse, complementary and indispensable. And you... you're merely the chosen... discarded piece!

text.content: The words 'discarded piece' struck like a heavy hammer against Chen Ji's heart. His pupils contracted sharply, countless images flashing through his mind—the mocking gazes when his spiritual root was found to be impure in childhood, the humiliation of being kicked out of the Inner Sect as a teenager, and that suffocating sensation of having his fate strangled by the throat every time he used the Tianji Record. Were all these... arranged by someone? His fists clenched until his knuckles cracked, yet his expression remained undisturbed.

dialogue.content: The true Twins of Destiny—one is your master Ling Yuan, the other... the black-clad figure deliberately paused, black mist coiling around his fingertips into a诡异的符文—a genius from three hundred years ago who single-handedly sealed the Demon Abyss, Chen Tiansheng! He is the true heavenly fate bearer, and you... merely the shadow in Chen Tiansheng's destiny, the sacrificial offering for his ending!

text.content: Chen Ji felt as if his mind had exploded. Ling Yuan... Chen Tiansheng... these two names churned like mighty waves in his heart. He had always thought Ling Yuan was merely an ambitious schemer coveting the Tianji Record, never expecting their destinies to be so intricately intertwined. And Chen Tiansheng, that hero who supposedly sacrificed himself to seal the Demon Abyss in legend—was actually his... shadow? Sacrificial offering? This truth was too horrifying, leaving him momentarily unable to digest it.

choice.prompt: The words of the demonic envoy were like a blade, precisely stabbing into the most vulnerable corner of Chen Ji's heart. Faced with this sudden blow of truth, how should he respond?

choices.text: Go along with the flow, probe the Demonic Path's true intentions
choices.description: Since the Demonic Path is willing to tell him these secrets, it means they have schemes. Might as well follow their words and find out what they truly want.
choices.visible_reward: Gather Demonic Path intelligence, seize initiative
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path folk are cunning as foxes—one misstep and you'll fall into their trap

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, completely suppressing the raging waves in his heart. He raised his eyes to stare directly at the black-clad figure, a glint of amusement flickering in his gaze: Interesting. Since you know more than I do, why not tell me—what does the Demonic Path want me to do? His tone was casual, as if the earlier shock had never occurred. The black-clad figure was clearly surprised by his reaction but immediately showed a satisfied smile.

choices.text: Retreat to advance, play the pig to eat the tiger to the end
choices.description: The more he speaks grandiosely, the more he's testing my reaction. Better to pretend I'm a shatteredtrash, letting him fail to gauge my true depth.
choices.visible_reward: Make the enemy underestimate me, secretly arrange pieces
choices.risk_hint: If the other party truly possesses key information, may miss a golden opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji's form swayed, as if this speech had shattered his final psychological defense. He stepped back, supporting himself against the nearby stone table, his face pale as paper: You... are you telling the truth? His voice trembled, the light in his eyes fading. Upon seeing this, the black-clad figure laughed even more triumphantly—for in his view, thistrash had been completely crushed.

choices.text: Take the initiative, expose the opponent's flaws
choices.description: Flaws! There must be flaws in his words! Since the Twins of Destiny are so important, why would the Demonic Path proactively tell him? The logic here doesn't add up!
choices.visible_reward: Disrupt the enemy's rhythm, master initiative in the conversation
choices.risk_hint: If judgment is wrong, may sharpen contradictions

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly laughed lightly, that laugh sounding especially jarring in the寂静的夜色中. He stood with hands behind his back, the earlier dejection completely gone, replaced by a chilling sharpness: Since I'm merely a sacrificial弃子, why go to such great lengths to tell me this? Demonic Path people offering unsolicited kindness have ulterior motives. His gaze was like a blade, piercing straight into the black-clad figure's eyes, speak, what exactly do you want?

dialogue.content: The black-clad figure was stunned by his reaction, then burst into laughter: Good! Good a Chen Ji! No wonder the Saintess selected you—you're truly no ordinary person. His smile faded, tone turning cold, but do you think this is the end? The Commander said you must either acknowledge being one of the Twins of Destiny and cooperate with the Holy Sect, or... his gaze swept across the house behind Chen Ji, where your sister Chen Nian has been waiting... not long enough.

text.content: The two characters Chen Nian struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. His pupils contracted sharply, his fingers holding the teacup trembling slightly—those characters were his逆鳞, his greatest软肋. Three years... he had thought his sister died in that catastrophe, yet never expected... she was still alive? And in the Demonic Path's hands? His heart raced violently, yet he forced himself to remain calm. Since the other party used this as leverage, it meant they hadn't acted yet—this was forcing him to submit.

dialogue.content: Looks like you still care greatly about that girl. The black-clad figurescoffed一声, the Holy Sect has taken good care of her, after all she is the key to opening the Ancient Forbidden Land—oh right, should say the seal. As long as she's in our hands, your incomplete Tianji Record will never be able to peer into complete fate. How about it, is this诚意 sufficient? He stepped forward, black mist nearly吞没 Chen Ji's figure, just nod your head, and you siblings can reunite.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, moonlight falling on his face, revealing a completely expressionless visage. His gaze wascalm得可怕, like a dead pool of water, showing no emotional fluctuation whatsoever. But deep within, countless thoughts raced frantically: Ling Yuan, Chen Tiansheng, Twins of Destiny, Chen Nian, Tianji Record... these fragments were reassembling into a terrifying picture. So from the very beginning, he was merely a piece on someone else's chessboard.

The black-clad figure seemed quite satisfied with his silence, thinking he was making a difficult choice. He turned leisurely, black mist churning behind him: In three days, the Ancient Forbidden Land opens. If you don't appear by then, don't blame the Holy Sect for being disrespectful to your sister. His figure gradually merged into the night, his final words like a venomous snake's whisper: Chen Ji, think carefully. The truth of the Twins of Destiny is far more terrifying than you imagine...

When the figure of the demonic envoy completely vanished into that eerie black mist, the teacup in Chen Ji's hand suddenly shattered. Not from anger—quite the opposite, at this moment he was terrifyingly calm. He looked down at the shards in his palm, blood dripping between his fingers, yet his gaze was like eternal glacial ice. Acknowledge being the discarded piece of the Twins of Destiny? Accept being a弃子? A讥诮 curve appeared at the corner of his lips. Fine, you want to play chess—I'll play with you.

He turned and pushed open the door, his gaze falling on that dim oil lamp in the corner. Three years of arranging pieces, three years of忍, he had thought his chessboard was perfect enough. But tonight he finally understood—the true chess masters never entered the game—they merely watched from above, waiting for him step by step to walk toward the ending they had designed. Ling Yuan, Chen Tiansheng, Chen Nian... these names盘旋反复 in his mind. His fingers gently brushed his chest, where the Tianji Record Fragment wasslightly发烫.
